name: windflow
description: Independent Agent Skills for investigation, design, implementation, review, writing, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Choose a skill or coordinate the complete workflow.
interface.longDescription: Nine independently installable skills cover investigation, interviews, design, planning, implementation, acceptance, review, delivery, and writing. The optional Windflow coordinator connects them through shared context, user decisions, and evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $windflow to investigate this request, agree on the behavior, compare designs, and deliver verified changes. Wait for my ticket-breakdown and final merge confirmations.
